subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: How one couple turned a late-night slip into a weekly tradition that brought them closer. Read their story.
body_paragraphs: Last week, a SoulPlan user named Mia sent us a message at 2AM: 'I accidentally hit Tonight's Date.' She expected chaos. Instead, her partner saw the 'thought of you tonight' screen, smiled, and they were on the couch laughing within ten minutes. That 'mistake' became their new Friday ritual.

Mia and her partner had been stuck in the same dinner-and-TV loop for months. One tap on a mood—cozy—and the AI served up a card with a simple idea: a blanket fort and their favorite board game. No planning, no debate. Just a spark that made them feel seen again.

This is what happens when you trust the app to take the wheel. Tonight's Date is right there on your home screen: one tap on a mood, and the night plans itself. No scrolling, no fatigue. It's the reason couples who use it in the first 24 hours plan 4x more dates over the next month.
Open SoulPlan now and tap Tonight's Date with a mood you both love. See what happens. P.S. Mia's partner now says that 2AM mistake was the best thing that ever happened to their calendar.
